parties: Belding India Limited (acquirer) | Evolve IT Solutions Private Limited (target, formerly held by existing promoters/shareholders)
headline: Khaitan & Co advises Belding India on 100% acquisition of Evolve IT Solutions
sum: Belding India acquired 100% of Evolve IT Solutions for ₹10.75 crore, marking entry into India's indigenous security screening and critical infrastructure technology sector. The deal, closed within strict timelines via share purchase agreement and deed of assignment, adds X-ray baggage scanning, cargo inspection, and dental X-ray capabilities to Belding's diversified technology and manufacturing portfolio.
implication: Arm's-length subsidiary acquisition by a listed company of a defence-critical technology player structured with no regulatory or governmental pre-approval required, signalling India's willingness to streamline M&A in strategic security sectors where indigenous manufacturing meets ATM/Make-in-India objectives.
detail: Belding India, a listed technology and engineering company (formerly Synthiko Foils), acquired Pune-based Evolve IT Solutions-one of India's few indigenous OEM manufacturers of X-ray generators, imaging software, baggage scanners, and dental X-ray systems. The acquisition, valued at 0.5x Evolve's FY25 turnover of ₹20.81 crore (vs FY24 ₹14.81 crore), was disclosed under SEBI Regulation 30 within 24 hours of Board approval. Khaitan & Co negotiated and documented the share purchase agreement and deed of assignment to close within strict timelines; the transaction involved no promoter conflicts and required no sector regulator (defence, export, manufacturing) pre-clearance, indicating minimal compliance friction for strategic asset acquisitions in this domain.

framework.note: Due diligence baseline: target had no IBC filings or creditor disputes disclosed

structure.consideration: ₹10.75 crore (cash, assumed; not specified as equity consideration). Valuation metric: 0.5x FY25 turnover (₹20.81 cr), implying strategic asset-purchase model rather than earnings multiple.
conditions: Arm's-length transaction: no promoter involvement or related-party conflicts
100% equity stake acquisition from existing promoters/shareholders (multi-seller or single-seller not specified)
Transaction closed within 'very strict timelines' per legal documentation by Khaitan & Co
No conditions precedent disclosed; no regulatory approvals required (defence, export, FDI, etc.)
approvals: Board of Directors of Belding India Limited (approved)
No governmental or regulatory pre-approvals required (defence ministry, customs, atomic energy, etc.)
No sectoral regulator gating (Ministry of Defence/DPP, SEBI sectoral restrictions, or FDI caps not triggered)
structure.novel: Seamless M&A closure in strategic defence-adjacent technology sector (indigenous X-ray/security scanning) without mandatory government review-suggesting India's regulatory posture towards consolidation of domestic OEM capabilities is non-interventionist where (a) acquisition is cash-funded arm's-length deal, (b) target remains Indian-owned, and (c) no immediate export/FDI/sensitive tech licensing issues arise.

triggers.note: Triggered at board approval; 100% subsidiary acquisition classified as material event requiring immediate disclosure to stock exchange (BSE 513307)

triggers.law: Companies Act 2013, Section 373 (subsidiary definition & consolidated reporting)
triggers.note: Triggered: Evolve becomes wholly-owned subsidiary; Belding must consolidate Evolve's financials from acquisition date (23 Jul 2026) in Q1/Q2 FY27 onwards

triggers.law: Transfer of Property Act / Deed of Assignment (tangible + intangible IP)
triggers.note: Triggered: transfer of manufacturing facility (MIDC Bhosari, Pune, owned/leased), X-ray generator designs, imaging software, product trademarks, warranty contracts, customer agreements
Contextual: dental X-ray product line may require BARC/AERB licensing for continued manufacture; licensing typically transfers with facility; no show-stopper
